facts.en: Completed a garment-repair certificate at Fictional Thimblebrook Centre in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构顶针溪中心完成服装修补证书课程。

facts.en: The course covered hand stitches, basic domestic-machine seams and garment-care labels; it was not an industrial-machinery qualification.
facts.zh: 该课程涵盖手工针法、家用缝纫机基本缝线及服装护理标签；并非工业机械操作资格。

facts.en: Paid wardrobe assistant at Fictional Marigold Stage from 2023-02 to 2026-07, usually working evening performance calls.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-07 在虚构金盏花舞台任有薪服装助理，通常参加晚间演出值班。

facts.en: Checked costume pieces against cast-specific rail lists before performances.
facts.zh: 演出前依据对应演员的衣架清单核对服装部件。

facts.en: Replaced loose buttons and repaired small opened seams using methods approved by the wardrobe supervisor.
facts.zh: 使用服装主管批准的方法更换松动纽扣并修补小范围开线。

facts.en: Recorded repairs needing specialist attention and set those garments aside for the supervisor.
facts.zh: 记录需专业处理的修补事项，并将这些服装留给主管处理。

facts.en: Maintained laundry bags and care-label records; specialist cleaning was handled by an external supplier.
facts.zh: 维护洗衣袋及护理标签记录；专业清洁由外部供应商负责。

facts.en: Prepared quick-change sets according to the dresser’s marked sequence without designing the performance change plan.
facts.zh: 依据服装师标明的顺序准备快速换装套件，不设计演出换装方案。

facts.en: Reorganized repair tags for a 2025-09 production with the wardrobe supervisor.
facts.zh: 2025-09 与服装主管共同整理某部演出剧目的修补标签。

facts.en: Personally added garment IDs and repair-request dates; the supervisor assigned repair priority.
facts.zh: 个人添加服装编号及修补申请日期；修补优先级由主管分配。

facts.en: At the final dress rehearsal, 46 of 48 listed costume pieces were on their assigned rails; the 2 exceptions were with the cleaning supplier.
facts.zh: 在最终带妆彩排时，清单上的 48 件服装中有 46 件位于指定衣架；另外 2 件在清洁供应商处。

facts.en: That rail check recorded location, not a measured reduction in costume faults or production delays.
facts.zh: 该衣架检查记录位置，并非对服装故障或制作延误减少量的测量。

facts.en: Uses hand-sewing tools, a domestic sewing machine and spreadsheet rail lists.
facts.zh: 使用手工缝纫工具、家用缝纫机及电子表格衣架清单。

facts.en: Use of an industrial overlock machine is not recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录工业包缝机使用经历。

facts.en: Volunteered as a costume mender for Fictional Pebble Dance Circle during 2022-04 to 2022-11.
facts.zh: 2022-04 至 2022-11 志愿为虚构卵石舞蹈社修补服装。

facts.en: For that volunteer group, hand-sewed ribbon closures on 14 practice skirts designed by another member.
facts.zh: 为该志愿团体，在另一名成员设计的 14 条练习裙上手缝丝带系扣。

facts.en: Also performed in the group’s amateur dance showcase; the sewing and performance roles were unpaid.
facts.zh: 还参加该团体的业余舞蹈展演；缝纫及表演角色均无薪。

facts.en: Keeps a personal stitch-sample notebook with dated photos of practice seams.
facts.zh: 保留个人针法样本笔记，附有标注日期的练习缝线照片。

facts.en: Enjoys making fabric bookmarks for friends.
facts.zh: 爱好为朋友制作布艺书签。

facts.en: Handed over unresolved repairs in writing to the next evening’s wardrobe assistant.
facts.zh: 以书面方式将未解决的修补事项交接给下一晚的服装助理。
